_note: Body for POST /api/physical-test (app/main.py:4860; queued job physical.record, runtime/release.py:2894). Operator credential required (default-deny route gate). Every <...> is a measurement the tester takes; nothing here may be filled from the pattern or the twin. Send only after production has drafted or certified hexagon-coaster-set@1.2.0 (it has never been drafted there; the LISTREADY release seeds it). Otherwise _load_examined_cir refuses the sample.
tester_ref: <the ref returned by POST /api/tester/agreement for this tester; never 'owner'>

grams_by_color.cream: <grams of cream used for ALL FOUR coasters (start weight minus end weight)>
grams_by_color.wine: <grams of wine used for ALL FOUR coasters>

ball_band_grams: <grams per ball, from the label (both colours must be the same yarn line: only one band is accepted)>
measured_width_cm: <across the points, cm, unstretched: the mean of the four coasters>
measured_height_cm: <across the flats, cm, unstretched: the mean of the four coasters>
measured_around_cm: <perimeter, cm: the mean of the four coasters>
hours: <total hours for all four, including weaving in ends>
instructions_followed: <true only if the tester followed the US or UK PDF exactly>
notes: <terms used (US/UK); swatch: sts and rounds per 10 cm; each coaster's three measurements; yarn brand and fibre; every place the tester guessed, re-read or ripped back, by round number>
_pass_rule: passed = yardage factor (measured metres / twin metres, cream 22.6 + wine 6.2 = 28.8 m) between 0.4 and 2.5, no ERROR finding, and every reported dimension within 12% of the twin (width 9.7 cm, flats 8.4 cm, perimeter 29.0 cm). Making fewer than four coasters gives a factor near 0.25 and does not pass.
